task_name: Build Small Factory and Produce Metal

when_to_do_it.trigger_condition: When the Industrial Buildings icon shows a '1' badge and raw Metal is needed for residential upgrades and commercial crafting.
when_to_do_it.strategic_reasoning: Small Factories produce free raw materials (Metal, Wood) that form the base of the entire city economy.
when_to_do_it.placement_rule: Place next to the Coal Power Plant on the industrial end of the road, away from residential homes to minimize pollution overlap.

steps.who: Industrial Buildings icon on the right menu

steps.briefing: drag the Small Factory onto the road to the left of the Coal Power Plant.
confirm placement of the Small Factory.
drag Metal onto the factory twice to fill both production slots.
wait a few seconds for the tutorial Metal production to finish.

steps.who: floating Metal icons above the Small Factory
steps.briefing: collect the forged Metal into storage.
